correctness.rationale: For every integer L>=3 and p,v>0, define z=exp(-p/(2v)) in (0,1). The explicit four-class unnormalized state weights sum exactly to B_L(1+z^2)+z and obey all seven disjoint incoming balance identities of the comoving one-dwell Markov kernel. Full tours implement with positive probability any allowed elementary exclusion hop and have no-hop self-loops, so irreducibility implies unique stationary distribution. Only occupied adjacent-pair states create nonzero net signed hop, yielding Delta=-(1-z)^2/T and J=v Delta/L. Direct expansions verify all three asymptotic limits. Exact polynomial balance was checked on L=3..20; independent stationary linear solves on L=3..11 at three z values. Finite checks are supplementary, not the all-size proof. All scripts are complete standalone files.

value.rationale: Two particles are the minimal sector with hard-core interaction effects and a nonzero moving-defect-induced directed current (one particle has symmetric exits and zero current). For the physically motivated 2014 model, existing exact currents contain unresolved pair/triple correlations and explicit predictions use mean-field closure. The new complete all-L stationary measure and exact finite-speed backward-current formula resolve that natural minimal-interaction gap and supply exact ring-size and drive-speed limits. This is a parameter-complete analytic benchmark, not an arbitrarily chosen isolated numerical invariant or mere rephrasing of known qualitative negative transport.
